identity.title: Issue the grasp anatomy input package
identity.done_when_verbatim: One versioned package carries supported mappings, parameters, provenance and explicit gaps. Material-first addition: Package the skeletal/tissue/interface graph and each explicit reduction; removal of represented tissue must remove its mechanical connection.
identity.card_observation_verbatim: Anatomy completion does not itself prove climbing
identity.card_falsifier_verbatim: Wrong owner/frame, hidden outside placement, clipped/occluded subject or label ambiguity fails. View toggles must preserve the physical state hash.

mutant_frame.anchor: macaque hand body origin (wrist joint location 0 0 0 of the macaque wrist custom joint)
mutant_frame.correspondence: recorded A05 anchor transfer (anchors recorded verbatim in the macaque hand frame); not a new fit

osim_hand_frame.note: osim macaque hand body frame; muscle path locations are declared in their owning body's frame

frame_chain.law: every packaged position carries its source frame declaration; NO transform is composed between frames and NO new fit is recorded (C01: the round-trip/handedness/landmark verification is registered as still REQUIRED downstream)
frame_chain.osim_model_frame_note: M02 graph_pins body_frames (11 frames incl. ground/sternum/clavicle/scapula) stay a pinned REFERENCE for the C01 chain; shoulder-chain bodies are outside the grasp-scope package (explicit, not silent)

bonds_carried.parent_note: wrist dof carried on the anchor body; the forearm attachment is outside the A05 mutation record

law_statement.no_silent_bond: containment edges and rig parentage are placement/ontology only; a mechanical bond or a tissue-to-bone attachment exists only through its explicit record with explicit_declaration provenance and (for attachments) an identified interface
law_statement.waypoints: a waypoint is a path shape record, never an attachment port: interface=None, bond=False

skeletal_graph.note: bonds and containment edges are carried verbatim; A06 law: containment edges and rig parentage are placement/ontology only; a mechanical bond or tissue-to-bone attachment exists only through its explicit record
